# `ew verify-derived`

1 subcommand path(s). The synopsis lists the flags; `ew help` prints the positional arguments too.

## `ew verify-derived`

```text
ew verify-derived [--project <project>] [--json]
```

Stability: preview.

| Flag | Takes a value | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `--project` | yes | no |
| `--json` | no | no |

**Exit codes**

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | no difference |
| 1 | differences |
| 2 | usage and open errors |

**Result** (`--json`): `ew.verify-derived-result/1`, schema [`ew.verify-derived-result-1.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/bin/ew/schemas/ew.verify-derived-result-1.schema.json).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | `"ew.verify-derived-result/1"` | yes |  | The name of this schema. |
| `differences` | array of string | yes |  | The keys whose memoised value differs from the cold one. |
| `families` | map of integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | The keys read per query family (one pass). |
| `keys` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | The keys read in one pass. |
| `oracle` | array of [`OracleMismatch`](#oraclemismatch) | yes |  | What the memo oracle found. |

### OracleMismatch

One mismatch of the memo oracle.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cold` | string | yes |  | The cold value, as `Debug` text. |
| `family` | string | yes |  | The query family. |
| `key` | string | yes |  | The key, as `Debug` text. |
| `memoised` | string | yes |  | The memoised value, as `Debug` text. |
